units.source_text: 水木龙助、真一兄弟俩的父亲邀请太吉郎上圆山公园左阿弥饭馆吃晚饭。

en.t: The father of the brothers Mizuki Ryusuke and Shinichi invited Takichiro to dinner at Saami in Maruyama Park.

units.source_text: 冬季日短，从高处的饭馆房间里居高临下鸟瞰，市街上都已掌灯。

en.t: In winter the days were short, and looking down from the room of the restaurant high above, the streets of the city were already lit.

units.source_text: 天空一片灰蒙蒙，没有晚霞。

en.t: The sky was all gray and hazy, with no evening glow.

units.source_text: 街上除了点点灯火，也显得阴沉沉的。

en.t: Apart from the scattered points of lamplight, the streets too looked gloomy.
That was the color of winter in Kyoto.
